c64-ChaCha20-Poly1305 vendored library snapshot
=================================================

*** RETAINED FOR REFERENCE — NOT BUILT ***

Nothing builds this snapshot any more. examples/smoke_test now links the
repository's own src/ tree (the current library); see ../../Makefile and
../../README.md.

Why it was dropped as the example's build target: this snapshot documents
`aead_tag` as aead_encrypt's output — src/lib/data_lib.s exports it, and
src/lib/chacha20poly1305_lib.s's header lists it under "Output:" as
"authentication tag" — but contains no `sta aead_tag` anywhere. The only
occurrences are the `.import` at chacha20poly1305_lib.s:38, comments at
:22 and :448, and the verify-side `eor aead_tag,x` at :459. aead_encrypt
therefore never populates its own documented output.

An example pinned here could only report PASS by asserting on something
other than the API it claims to validate, which makes it a worked example
of how *not* to validate a library. The library sources under src/ are
left byte-for-byte unmodified (only this note was added) so the history
and the vendoring layout stay readable.

Upstream:  https://github.com/JC-000/c64-ChaCha20-Poly1305
Tag:       v0.3.0 (simulated; library contents taken from current HEAD)
Commit:    83f208f54e15c290a6ac082ed9b562c87d8748c3
Unpacked:  examples/smoke_test/third_party/c64-chacha20poly1305-v0.3.0/

This directory is a snapshot simulation of what a downstream consumer
(e.g. c64-wireguard, c64-https) would unpack from a GitHub release
tarball:

    tar xzf c64-chacha20poly1305-v0.3.0.tar.gz
    mv c64-ChaCha20-Poly1305-0.3.0 third_party/c64-chacha20poly1305-v0.3.0

Contents mirrored from the upstream repo at the listed commit:

    src/lib/*.s           library sources (chacha20, poly1305, AEAD, data,
                          word32, constants — the ca65 modules that link
                          into the consumer's build)
    src/include/ca65hl/   vendored ca65hl macro package (BSD-3-Clause,
                          see ca65hl/LICENSE)
    src/include/smc.inc   self-modifying-code helpers
    src/c64.cfg           upstream linker config (for reference only —
                          this example uses its own smoke_test.cfg at
                          the parent directory)

The consumer's build formerly (see ../../Makefile) pointed ca65 at
src/lib/ + src/include/ and linked the library objects together with
the consumer's own main module (../../smoke_test.s) against the
consumer's own linker config (../../smoke_test.cfg). That build line now
points at ../../../../src instead.

No edits have been made to the vendored files. A real release would
ship these under a top-level c64-ChaCha20-Poly1305-0.3.0/ directory;
the flatter layout here just shortens the example paths.
